title: Seven unreferenced Network kit placeholder PNGs (7.5 MB) stop shipping in public

verify.note: Fails before the change: the seven placeholder-0N.png files exist.

detail: public/sites/network-kit/photos carried placeholder-01..07.png (0.7 to 1.5 MB each, 7.5 MB). Nothing in lib, components or app references them (the Designer kit's placeholder-0N keys resolve to dz-*.webp). Removed. Still open from the same scan, not part of this row: Alli Rae bath-hero.webp is 1.3 MB and path-logo.jpg 0.5 MB for a logo; both are referenced, so they need a resize rather than a delete.
